<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This channel covers the perks we suggest for your gear and how to obtain them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>When you see symbols in a listed perk (+ and X):</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ + represents an item with </nowiki><strong><nowiki>multiple gizmos slots</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• E.g., </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088769982475.png?v=1" alt="p6" title="p6" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502339891331093.png?v=1" alt="as1" title="as1" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712074245202772009.png?v=1" alt="as4" title="as4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1214416336797564959.png?v=1" alt="eruptive2" title="eruptive2" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ X - represents where you have </nowiki><strong><nowiki>a choice of perks</nowiki></strong><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• E.g., </nowiki><em><nowiki>'Biting 4 X'</nowiki></em><nowiki> you could choose between 9 different perks to go with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1" alt="biting4" title="biting4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> depending on your preference</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These combinations are listed in the later sections of this channel</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span><nowiki>#invention-basics</nowiki></span><nowiki> is a must-read if you're new to Invention </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250946695292.png?v=1" alt="invention" title="invention" kind="icon" /><nowiki>

⬥ </nowiki><span><nowiki>#perk-information</nowiki></span><nowiki> describes every perk we recommend.

⬥</nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Perks/Search <nowiki>RuneScape Wiki's Perk Search</nowiki>]<nowiki> lets you search a perk combination to find which component setup is best.

⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Perks <nowiki>RuneScape Wiki's Perk Calculator</nowiki>]<nowiki> lets you test out component combinations and see your chance of different perks.

⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Shattered_Worlds <nowiki>Shattered Worlds</nowiki>]<nowiki> is the fastest way to level up your augmented gear.
    • Video guides: </nowiki>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oy0IZCZWTn0 <nowiki>Base Tank</nowiki>]<nowiki> / </nowiki>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bOeknuojYtI <nowiki>Evil Lucario</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Alternatively, level up your gear using a slayer mob in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#rs3-slayer</nowiki></span><nowiki>.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
